title: Interior Design & Turnkey Apartment Renovation in Vienna, 115 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 115 m² apartment interior design in Vienna by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. Complete project including interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation in Vienna. 3D visualizations and photos of the completed interior.
h1: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Vienna, 115 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Vienna, 115 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN completed a comprehensive project for a 115 m² apartment in Vienna, Austria, covering interior design and technical documentation, custom furniture production, furnishing and turnkey renovation.

The interior design includes the living room, bedroom, kitchen, walk-in wardrobes, entrance hall, bathroom, built-in wardrobes, shelving and storage systems. All spaces were developed within a unified contemporary concept with a strong focus on functionality, ergonomics and everyday comfort.

Particular attention was given to custom-made furniture. The furniture was designed together with the interior, allowing wardrobes, storage systems and the kitchen with integrated appliances to be precisely incorporated into the architecture and layout of the apartment.

Before implementation, a detailed project estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing works, materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment, lighting and other required items. Following the design stage, the turnkey apartment renovation in Vienna was completed according to the developed technical documentation.

The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations and photographs of the completed interior, making it possible to compare the original design concept with the finished apartment and evaluate the accuracy of its implementation.
